title: Professional Certificate Course in Employment Contract Terms
description: The aim of this course is to educate participants about express terms and the key terms of an employment contract.
longDescription: Employment Legislation. Key Issues Covered in the Employment Legislation. What is Employment Contract? Types of Employment Contracts. Contractual Terms. Express Terms. Key Terms of Employment Contract. Key types of Employee Rights. Through this course, you'll gain the key issues and concepts related to Employment Legislation, including employment contracts, types of employment contracts, and contractual terms. You'll learn about express terms and explore the key terms of an employment contract. In addition, you'll discover the different types of employee rights, including those related to working hours, minimum wage, and discrimination. This course is ideal for those who want to gain a deep understanding of Employment Legislation and its implications for employers and employees.
